key_naming: sb = StatsBomb side, wy = Wyscout/Pappalardo side, as one _-separated part of a key that concerns one provider (E-11 PIPELINE section 0, key names); no key at any depth of this file, of calibration.json, of either results.json or of results.local.json contains statsbomb, pappalardo or wyscout in any letter case or starts with SB_ (tests/test_licensing.py reads the keys of every JSON file under experiments/ for the first and the prefix; the runner test of PIPELINE section 10 for all three)
verified_by_root_before_registration: pipeline_spec_sha256: lf_sha256 of PIPELINE.md as registered

sb_folder_digests: the folder_manifest digest of each 2015/16 folder, computed from the files on disk by E-11's rule (E-11 PIPELINE section 2); the La_Liga value must equal E-11's registered value; a null value refuses execute

sb_vocabulary_checked_folders: the category names of event kind, pass type, shot type and duel type in Premier_League, Serie_A and Ligue_1, compared with E-11's four sb_known_* lists, names only and no counts; a name outside a list is reported in the registration commit and the draft is audited again before registration
dependency_config_sha256 and dependency_protocol_sha256: lf_sha256 of E-11's registered config.json and preregistration.md
dependency_source_sha256: lf_sha256 of the three E-11 modules E-12 imports, as they stand at registration
counted_by_root_before_registration: structure only, run by the root on lineups, rosters and match lists before registration and computing no outcome, printed in the registration commit in Markdown with the credit: per cohort of the structural table and per floor pair, the linked units whose two labels agree (ROLE_SAME) and those whose labels differ (ROLE_CHANGED) under sb_modal_broad_position_rule, the distinct origin and destination clubs among the ROLE_SAME units, and the modal-rule ties and unmapped position names
counted_by_root_rule: a count outside what preregistration.md states for it is printed in the registration commit; a ROLE_SAME count that changes which gate a contrast is expected to fail is stated beside the gate in the registration commit; no constant of this file moves
root_rulings_rule: ROOT-DECISIONS 2.8 (16 and 18 October 2026) binds E-12: Y1 and Y2 restrict every verdict of the cross_corpus arm to ROLE_SAME units and report ROLE_CHANGED units as a descriptive stratum outside the graded ordering; Y3 prints the ROLE_CHANGED share beside each contrast and recomputes the gates and power statements for ROLE_SAME units; Y4 makes the admitted set a function of E-11's registry tokens read from verdicts.py at run time, refuses to start while an E-11 record read is PENDING, and lets E-12 be registered before E-11 runs. Questions this revision puts to the root are in PIPELINE.md, DISSENT
dependency_machine_rule: the surface hashes are bitwise and depend on the BLAS kernel the CPU selects (E-11 PIPELINE section 14, item 8): execute refuses unless platform.platform(), platform.processor(), the BLAS library and version numpy reports and the versions of python, numpy, pandas and pyarrow equal E-11's provenance.packages; a surface hash that differs on that machine is a failed run (exit 3), never a loosened comparison

admission_rule.registry_token: the token of verdicts.py record E-11/<construct> read at run time; it must equal results.json verdicts[<construct>].token of E-11, else execute refuses
admission_rule.admitted_iff: registry token in dependency_agreeing_tokens and admission status in dependency_admitting_statuses
admission_rule.reason_when_not_admitted: the first of not_admitted_reasons that holds: the registry token's reason, then E-11's exclusion reason
printed_beside_every_result: the _LEAGUE_UNCONFIRMED suffix when the status carries it

primary_designation_effect: reporting order and the headline of analysis.md only; every construct and contrast has its own verdict and label, and no verdict is counted with another
construct_definition_rule: numerator, denominator, scale and minimum_denominator equal E-11's aggregated_player_quantities entry of the same key (asserted at run time); a unit, or a half, whose denominator is zero or below minimum_denominator is a hole; the floors are E-12's own
surface_rule: sb_reference_open_play = statsbomb_reference_surface(sb_root, e11_config, variant='open_play'), hash equal to E-11's provenance.xt.sb_reference_open_play.hash; wy_reference = wyscout_reference_surface(spain_actions, <the Wyscout game ids of E-11's linked La Liga matches>, e11_config), hash equal to E-11's provenance.xt.wy_reference.hash; wy_public_spain = wyscout_reference_surface(spain_actions, [], e11_config): the same fit rule on every Spain 2017/18 match, no match excluded, built before any licensed path is opened, reading no StatsBomb file and no E-11 result
xt_recipe: experiments.run_external_replication.fit_xt rule, as frozen in E-11 (xt_recipe, xt_turnover_rule, xt_grid of E-11's config), through E-11's surface functions only

link_tier_definitions.P: a PAIRED_BY_TEAM_SHEET pair of E-11's team-sheet crosswalk, rebuilt in memory by E-11's own calls (PIPELINE section 6)
link_tier_definitions.A: E-11's wide link with tier set [A], called as name_nationality_link(left, right, e11_config, tiers=['A'], exclude_right=None, unique_right=True): the StatsBomb legal name token set equals the Wyscout first-plus-last-name token set on name_tokens, at least link_tier_a_minimum_tokens tokens, nationality agrees; a right record reached by two or more lefts makes all of them CLAIMED_TWICE; no nickname

link_left_row_rule: left = every StatsBomb player with a regulation minute in a 2015/16 match of the four origin folders; his legal name, nickname and country are those of his read_team_sheets row in his last such match by (date, sb_game_id); players whose rows disagree on any of the three keep the last row's values and are counted (sb_people_disagreeing)
link_right_rule: right = every record of read_wyscout_people, built as evaluate_wide_link builds it (provider_crosswalk._right): right_id, full_name, countries = (birth_area, passport_area)
placebo_seed_rule: int.from_bytes(sha256(f'{seed}|{placebo_seed}|{pool_key}'.encode()).digest()[:8], 'big'), seed the config seed, placebo_seed one value of identity_placebo_seeds, pool_key the pool's values of identity_placebo_pool joined by '|'; units sorted by unit inside the pool
false_link_rule: F = e_fl * NA + e_ap * max(0, N0 - NP - NA * (1 - e_fl)); e = F / n_M; the loss row (decision row 7) is evaluable only when e_fl and e_ap are defined (wide link used) and e <= false_link_share_cap

club_name_sources.sb: read_matches home_team_name and away_team_name, by home_sb_team_id / away_sb_team_id
club_name_sources.wy: teams.parquet team_name by team_id (the adapter's unescaped name, as E-11's crosswalk reads it), for the team ids of read_wyscout_matches

main_club_rule: most regulation minutes in the season; a tie excludes the player
sb_modal_broad_position_rule: over the player's regulation spells at his main club in the season (spell minutes by sb_reader._spell with E-11's cap and regulation periods), minutes are summed per broad class after sb_broad_position_rule; the class with most minutes is his class; a tie goes to the tied class of the earliest spell by (date, sb_game_id, from_period, minute of from, place in the list); a spell whose name maps to no class adds to none and is counted; the same rule for every unit of the reference population
outfield_rule: cross_corpus: StatsBomb modal broad class is not GK and Wyscout role code is not GK; public: Wyscout role code is not GK
role_same_rule: a linked unit is ROLE_SAME when its StatsBomb modal broad class equals wy_position_map[its Wyscout role code]; ROLE_CHANGED otherwise
band_closure: left-closed: band 0 below the first edge, band k in [edge k, edge k+1), the last band at or above the last edge
half_assignment: the unit's own matches for the club in question, sorted by (date, game id); even position A, odd position B
half_floor_rule: one third of the floor of that side, in minutes
prior_matching_rule: per world, a stayer's weight is his world weight times (mover world weight in his cell / stayer world weight in his cell); a mover in a cell with no stayer world weight has weight 0 in that world; the point estimate uses unit weights through the same code
bootstrap_unit: origin club key (public arm: the club key of the before side)
bootstrap_sensitivity_units: destination club key (public arm: the club key of the after side)
world_rule: rng = default_rng(SeedSequence([seed, seed_streams.worlds])); weights = rng.multinomial(C, np.full(C, 1 / C), size=bootstrap_replicates), C the sorted club keys of the arm's corpus; one Worlds object per arm, shared by every construct, contrast, statistic and sensitivity
pseudo_mover_rule: n_M stayers drawn without replacement with probability proportional to their point matching weight; the point ratio of the drawn stayers against the rest, through the same estimator; the self-check holds when 1 lies inside the pseudo_mover_check_quantiles of the draws, bounds inclusive
analysed_unit_rule: n_S and n_M count, per construct and contrast, the units of the arm (cross_corpus: ROLE_SAME units only) with finite z_pre and z_post, and for movers in a prior-matching cell holding at least one such stayer; the same n enters every gate, the false-link share and required_movers; the clubs gate counts distinct origin club keys among those units
required_movers_rule: max(minimum_movers, ceil(3 + 1 / (maximum_inverse_n_sum - 1 / (n_S - 3)))); null when n_S <= 3 or the denominator is not positive
planning_basis: maximum_inverse_n_sum is the delta-method condition for planning_power of the raw-ratio lower bound alone at tau = 1 and an observed stayer correlation of planning_stayer_correlation; no basis is recorded for 0.75 as an observed cross-provider, two-season value or for the allowance 1.06; the simulated power of the whole survival row is printed in preregistration.md
attenuation_rule: rho* is defined only when each stepped-up reliability exceeds attenuation_minimum and each half correlation exceeds -1
comparison_rule: >= for a lower bound against the margin and the stayer floor, < for an upper bound against the margin, inclusive at both ends of the standing-shift margin; a None or NaN bound fails every row that reads it; a placebo result of None fails the placebo condition

registry_token_rule.rule: cross_corpus: the registry token is the decision token, with the suffix appended when the decision token is suffixed here and E-11's admission status of the construct ends with the suffix; public_winter: the decision token

transport_rule_coefficients_fitted_on: stayers only (z_post on [1, own_deviation, level_origin], with the stayers' prior-matching weights); movers are evaluation rows only
descriptive_outputs_rule: the ROLE_CHANGED stratum, sensitivities, contamination curve, rule comparison and the attrition z-contrasts are computed only for a construct admitted by E-11 and a contrast that passed decision rows 1 and 2; none reaches decide

sensitivity_definitions.single_club_movers: movers with one club in each season
sensitivity_definitions.origin_club_survived: units whose origin club key is in the 2017/18 corpus
sensitivity_definitions.stayers_top_flight_throughout: stayers whose club is not in second_tier_2016_17_clubs
sensitivity_definitions.all_movers_pooled: the stayers against M_w, M_x and M_b together
sensitivity_definitions.composition_matched: stayers reweighted to the movers' position x age band x destination minutes band
sensitivity_definitions.unmatched_ratio: the ratio with unit stayer weights and no prior matching
sensitivity_definitions.destination_club_worlds: worlds over destination club keys instead of origin club keys
sensitivity_definitions.player_bootstrap: units resampled within arm and position
sensitivity_definitions.floors_450: floors 450 / 450, cohorts, cells and panel rebuilt
sensitivity_definitions.floors_1350: floors 1350 / 1350, cohorts, cells and panel rebuilt

attrition_contrast_rule: among the ROLE_SAME linked units of a cohort with a 2017/18 appearance (at least one regulation minute at a destination club), the mean origin z of those who cleared the destination floor minus the mean of those who did not, with its decision interval; computed per admitted construct for contrasts that passed rows 1 and 2
role_changed_rule: per contrast that passed rows 1 and 2: the ROLE_CHANGED share of the linked units of each arm, and on ROLE_CHANGED units the rho of each arm and their ratio with intervals when each arm has at least minimum_units_for_any_statistic units; labelled outside the ordering E-11 graded; never reaches decide
role_changed_sentence: E-11 graded the ordering of these quantities within the Wyscout role code. The ordering of origin percentiles for players whose StatsBomb position and Wyscout role differ was not graded there, so those players enter no verdict here.
public_appearance_rule: a lineup row of read_wyscout_team_sheets with at least minimum_regulation_minutes_appearance regulation minutes
public_reference_population_rule: the cell (league, Wyscout role, side) holds every outfield player whose appearances in that league on that side of public_same_club_split_date are for one club and total at least the side floor, and every P_M unit on its own side in that league (before: the first club's matches; after: the second club's)
calibration_defaults_basis: a design grid, not formed from any corpus count
attribution_sb: Data source: StatsBomb. This analysis is formed from StatsBomb Open Data and is published under clause 1.4 of the StatsBomb Public Data User Agreement with the StatsBomb logo. The conclusions are not the opinions or analytical insights of StatsBomb.
attribution_wy: Pappalardo et al. (2019), A public data set of spatio-temporal match events in soccer competitions, Scientific Data 6:236, CC BY 4.0; figshare collection 4415000, articles Events (doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.7770599), Matches (doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.7770428), Players and Teams.

registry_cross_corpus.scope: Outfield players linked by name and nationality between StatsBomb open data 2015/16 (Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Ligue 1) and the public Pappalardo/Wyscout data 2017/18 (the same four leagues and the Bundesliga), at or above the frozen minutes at their main club in both seasons, whose broad position is the same under the two providers' labels; players who changed club against players who did not; within-league normal scores of E-11's harmonised estimator.

registry_public_winter.scope: Outfield players of the public Pappalardo/Wyscout data 2017/18 (five first divisions): players who moved between two clubs in the winter window against players who stayed at one club, before and after the window, with at least half the frozen minutes on each side.

registry_common.non_claim: Ordering among players, for players used at their next club. It is not a forecast for this player, not how much of his rate he keeps, and not transfer success.
registry_common.not_run_statement: E-12 is registered and not run. Whether players who changed club kept their ordering on {construct} as players who stayed did is untested.

NOT_ADMITTED.statement: The provider-agreement experiment did not admit {construct} for a comparison across the two data providers, so E-12 compared nothing on it.

INCONCLUSIVE.statement: E-12 did not reach its preregistered sample, or a data check failed, for {construct}. Nothing was compared.

ORDER_PERSISTS_WITHIN_MARGIN.statement: Among players used at their next club whose broad position was the same under both providers' labels, players who changed club kept their ordering on {construct} to within the preregistered margin of players who stayed, measured two seasons apart across two data providers, and their standing did not shift against stayers of the same prior standing by more than the margin. Ordering is not level: this does not say how much of a player's rate is kept. It is not a forecast for this player.

ORDER_PERSISTS_WITHIN_MARGIN_LEAGUE_UNCO.statement: Among players used at their next club whose broad position was the same under both providers' labels, players who changed club kept their ordering on {construct} to within the preregistered margin of players who stayed, measured two seasons apart across two data providers, and their standing did not shift against stayers of the same prior standing by more than the margin. Ordering is not level: this does not say how much of a player's rate is kept. It is not a forecast for this player. Provider agreement for this quantity was not confirmed on league matches alone; the research note prints both provider-agreement tokens beside this result.

ORDER_REDUCED_BEYOND_MARGIN.statement: Among players used at their next club whose broad position was the same under both providers' labels, players who changed club kept their ordering on {construct} less than players who stayed, beyond the preregistered margin, measured two seasons apart across two data providers. Ordering is not level: this does not say how much of a player's rate is kept, and a comparison of groups is not the effect of a move.

ORDER_REDUCED_BEYOND_MARGIN_LEAGUE_UNCON.statement: Among players used at their next club whose broad position was the same under both providers' labels, players who changed club kept their ordering on {construct} less than players who stayed, beyond the preregistered margin, measured two seasons apart across two data providers. Ordering is not level: this does not say how much of a player's rate is kept, and a comparison of groups is not the effect of a move. Provider agreement for this quantity was not confirmed on league matches alone; the research note prints both provider-agreement tokens beside this result.

NOT_ESTABLISHED.statement: E-12 compared players who changed club with players who stayed on {construct} and established neither preregistered conclusion: that ordering persisted within the margin with standing unshifted and the identity checks passed, or that it was reduced beyond the margin. Some criteria may have been met; the research note says which.

NOT_ESTABLISHED_LEAGUE_UNCONFIRMED.statement: E-12 compared players who changed club with players who stayed on {construct} and established neither preregistered conclusion: that ordering persisted within the margin with standing unshifted and the identity checks passed, or that it was reduced beyond the margin. Some criteria may have been met; the research note says which. Provider agreement for this quantity was not confirmed on league matches alone; the research note prints both provider-agreement tokens beside this result.

INCONCLUSIVE.statement: Too few players changed club in the 2017/18 winter window of the public data to reach E-12's preregistered sample for {construct}. Nothing was compared.

ORDER_PERSISTS_WITHIN_MARGIN.statement: In one season of the public data, players who changed club in the winter window kept their ordering on {construct} to within the preregistered margin of players who stayed, and their standing did not shift by more than the margin. Ordering is not level. It is not a forecast for this player.

ORDER_REDUCED_BEYOND_MARGIN.statement: In one season of the public data, players who changed club in the winter window kept their ordering on {construct} less than players who stayed, beyond the preregistered margin. Ordering is not level, and a comparison of groups is not the effect of a move.

NOT_ESTABLISHED.statement: In one season of the public data, E-12 compared winter-window movers with players who stayed on {construct} and established neither preregistered conclusion.

public_winter.sentence: Outfield players who changed club in the winter window with at least the side floor of minutes on each side.
The preregistered minimum of such players for a comparison.
The minutes floor on each side of the move or of the split date.
Outfield players who stayed at one club with at least the side floor of minutes on each side of the split date. They did not change club.
public_winter.when: when the same-club status is REPORTED

public_winter.sentence: Correlation of these players' standing among players of their league and position before and after the split date. It describes players who did not change club and is not an estimate for players who do.
public_winter.when: when the same-club status is REPORTED

public_winter.sentence: Lower end of the interval of that correlation (fifth and ninety-fifth percentiles of the resampling worlds).
public_winter.when: when the same-club status is REPORTED

public_winter.sentence: Upper end of the same interval.
public_winter.when: when the same-club status is REPORTED

product_governing_rule.inputs: origin league = the candidate's league (his club of latest appearance); destination league = the squad's league; both among the five leagues of the universe
order: destination is destination_only_league and origin is in overlap_leagues
product_governing_rule.subject: E-12 / {governing contrast}:{construct} for the five constructs; any other metric keeps its present lookup

product_copy.carried_value: The value shown is his rate at his current club, carried forward unchanged. No transport model is applied.
product_copy.estimator_note: E-12 tested the research estimator of this rate, fitted the same way in both seasons, not the one this page injects.

label.NOT_ADMITTED: Club change: not tested (provider agreement not established)
label.ORDER_PERSISTS_WITHIN_MARGIN: Club change: tested, movers' ordering persisted within margin
label.ORDER_REDUCED_BEYOND_MARGIN: Club change: tested, movers' ordering persisted less than stayers' beyond margin
label.NO_ORIGIN_SEASON: Club change: untestable here (no Bundesliga origin season)

product_copy.label_suffix_league_unconfirmed: (provider agreement not confirmed on league matches)
product_copy.no_origin_season_statement: The research corpus has no season in which the Bundesliga is the origin league. A move out of the Bundesliga, or within it, is untested for {construct}.
product_copy.carry_over_lead: Break-even carry-over fraction {fraction}: the declared conclusion holds if he keeps at least this fraction of his historical {scaled_metrics}. It predicts nothing; it states how much would have to persist.

carry_over_addendum.PENDING: Nothing measured here says how much persists.
carry_over_addendum.NOT_ADMITTED: Nothing measured here says how much persists (E-12: not tested for {construct}).
carry_over_addendum.INCONCLUSIVE: Nothing measured here says how much persists (E-12: sample gate, nothing compared for {construct}).
carry_over_addendum.ORDER_PERSISTS_WITHIN_MARGIN: E-12 found that movers' ordering on {construct} persisted within its margin. Ordering is not level: that finding says nothing about this fraction.
carry_over_addendum.ORDER_REDUCED_BEYOND_MARGIN: E-12 found that movers' ordering on {construct} persisted less than stayers'. Ordering is not level: nothing measured here says how much of a rate persists.
carry_over_addendum.NOT_ESTABLISHED: E-12 established neither conclusion for {construct}. Nothing measured here says how much persists.
carry_over_addendum.NO_ORIGIN_SEASON: Nothing measured here says how much persists after a move out of the Bundesliga.

product_copy.attribution_line: E-12 uses StatsBomb Open Data and the public Pappalardo/Wyscout data set. Research note and StatsBomb attribution: {research_note_path}

product_forbidden: any number, interval, count or coefficient from the cross_corpus arm on a hosted surface or in a committed machine-readable file
a cross_corpus verdict used as the gate of a number-bearing hosted panel or as a parameter of a served computation
any comparison of the break-even carry-over fraction with an E-12 ratio
colour, icon or wording that marks a break-even carry-over fraction as safe or unsafe
the words likely, expected or projected beside a carried-forward value
any sentence that reads an E-12 verdict as evidence about how much of a rate carries over, or that an assumption is argued against
